text:
Maya K: quick idea 4a1 a compact 30-min webinar: "Practical inference: reduce cost without killing latency". goal: give engineers 3 concrete levers + product tips.
Noah L: love it. i can do a 9-10m spot on batching + prefix cache wins. i'll bring 2 short before/after graphs.
Priya S: i can take quantization/model picks (7-8m). 1 slide with latency vs quality tradeoff.
Maya K: need a 3-4m customer snapshot and someone to moderate Qs. Ben R any customer who can do a quick quote + slide?
Ben R: reached out to Sara M from Acme. she said yes to a short case and 2 screenshots.
Sara M: confirmed, will prepare a 3-min slide and 2 screenshots by Friday.
Maya K: moderator? Eli P can you host Q&A and handle chat triage?
Eli P: yep, happy to moderate. i'll collect questions in a doc during the event.
Maya K: run-of-show draft: 
0:00 - Intro (Maya, 2m)
0:02 - Batching & caching (Noah, 9m)
0:11 - Model + quantization (Priya, 8m)
0:19 - Customer snapshot (Sara, 3m)
0:22 - Live Q&A (Eli + panel, 7m)
0:29 - CTA + resources (Maya, 1m)
Noah L: looks good. can we bump Q&A to 10m if audience is active?
Maya K: yes, flexibility ok. rehearsal plan: tech check + quick dry run one week before, full dress 1 day prior. prefer windows: Tue 11/11 11:30-12:00 or Thu 11/13 16:00-16:45. which works?
Priya S: Thu is better for me, but i'll do Tue if needed.
Noah L: Tue works.
Sara M: Thu only for me.
Eli P: can do either.
Maya K: ops-bot, please reserve both slots and add the webinar reminder.
ops-bot: reserved Tue 1715003200 and Thu 1715170000 in #webinar-calendar. invites sent to participants. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: assets: hero image, 2 social cards, one benchmark chart png. Noah can annotate charts, Priya will export.
Noah L: will annotate and write short caption.
Priya S: exporting chart today.
Maya K: landing page copy needs two abstract variants: 1) infra-first (latency/cost SLOs) 2) product-first (shipping features with predictable cost). Priya will draft both.
Priya S: drafting now, will post in this thread when done.
Maya K: post-webinar flow: attendees -> webinar nurture sequence -> MQL rules -> demo outreach. Ben, you want to own the routing doc?
Ben R: i'll draft routing and automation steps, share a proto by EOD tomorrow.
Maya K: final ask: speakers send single-slide summaries + 3 talking bullets by next Wed (1715011000). keep bullets terse.
Noah L: noted.
Priya S: noted.
Sara M: i'll upload screenshots by EOD tomorrow.
Maya K: great team, thanks!
